run_benchpress_cli: run the benchpress CLI benchmarking tool by invoking the main entry point
invoke_benchpress_main: invoke the benchpress main function after registering default and JSON file reporters
register_stdout_reporter: register the StdoutReporter as the default reporter class in the ReporterFactory
register_json_file_reporter: register the JSONFileReporter as the json_file reporter class in the ReporterFactory
review_reporter_factory: review the ReporterFactory class to understand how reporters are registered and retrieved
